items.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
items.description: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
items.description: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

items.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
items.description: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

items.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
items.description: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

items.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
items.description: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

items.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
items.description: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

items.title: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
items.description: The killing of the 16-year-old nearly a year ago had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about social media.

items.title: Immigrants held in small outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz' in Florida, investigators find
items.description: DHS inspectors say they found the immigration-detention centre violated basic standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety.

items.title: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
items.description: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote says he wants ordinary people to share in the success of his oil refinery.

items.title: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
items.description: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Four other women's bodies have been found nearby.

items.title: Zambians warned not to eat dead wildlife after anthrax kills dozens of animals
items.description: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.

items.title: Hyrox apologises for allowing race to continue after athlete soils herself
items.description: Some raised concerns around hygiene while others praised the competitor's resolve to finish the race and push through adversity.
